findings.summary: Blog page close: the label, two-tone statement and sub line are centered, but the email label, field and Subscribe button sit in a left-aligned block about 350px off the page edge, so the form does not align with the centered text above it. The reference's close centers its action pills under the statement.
Blog plate captions are still weak counts ('2 PARTS', '4 PARTS'). The store's captions ('18 OZ', 'TWILL') say more about the item. Carried over from the earlier round.

notes: Scope: one sample of each app. I read the blog, commerce and settings desktop screenshots in full, the commerce checkout-errors state and the cart, plus the reference p1-desktop-light.png. I did not open the dashboard shots, the mobile and dark captures, the drawing crops or the motion frames this round, so findings on those are not covered here.

Update goal (iterations.md, rc.5): reached. The commerce checkout form (state-checkout-errors-desktop-light.png) keeps its plain '02 / 02 Checkout' section heading with its mono counter and description. It has no display statement and no dot field. The cart stays side by side, with items on the left and the form on the right, which fixes the rc.4 major. The error banner sits above 'Place order'. The settings profile screen (settings-profile-desktop-light.png) ends on its form actions with plain section headings and no statement.

Real page close still works: the blog home ends on a mono label ('SUBSCRIBE TO THE NEWSLETTER') and the two-tone statement 'Get every post. Nothing else.' (primary lead, then secondary tone) over the dot field. It is one line at 1440px and matches the reference's close, which has the same two tones. The rule distinguishes the two cases correctly.

Regression check against rc.4 critic-2.json: its one major (a form's heading rewritten as the statement) is fixed. Nothing that was fine in rc.4 got worse in the screens I read. The rc.4 minors are not re-raised, apart from the caption count carried over.

Measured defect, commerce / repeated-drawing (desktop and mobile): false alarm. Eleven products share eight plate kinds, so a kind repeats only after the eighth, each time with a different caption (FIG 05 '240 GSM' and FIG 10 'BRASS'; FIG 06 'TWILL' and FIG 11 'ONE SIZE'). No kind repeats next to itself in a row or column (commerce home-desktop-light.png).
Scores are descriptive. Verdict basis: no blocker and no major, so the screen passes.
Not re-checked this round, so no verdict on them: the commerce product detail page, the dashboard, and mobile and dark closes.
